parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the associated product. You must use an instance that the invoker has access to and that actually exists. The instance must be consistent with the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definition
parameters.help_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dialogue scenario under the instance. Specify an existing scenario. Subsequent dialogues and end requests for the same text session must use the scenario specified when the session is started
parameters.help_zh: 实例下的对话场景标识。请填写实际存在的场景；同一文本会话的后续对话和结束请求应使用开启会话时的场景
parameters.name: script_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the client device that initiates the web voice call or receives data channel events. The same DeviceId must be used when the same client obtains data channel credentials and initiates a call. The example is only a business device identifier, not a real credential assigned by the platform
parameters.help_zh: 标识发起网页语音或接收数据通道事件的客户端设备。同一客户端获取数据通道凭证和发起呼叫时应使用相同的DeviceId；示例仅为业务设备标识，不是平台分配的真实凭证
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The caller information used to display and associate with the web call. It is not equivalent to the actual outbound caller phone number. If it is not provided or is empty, the current web call implementation uses the caller identifier as the caller display information
parameters.help_zh: 用于展示和关联网页呼叫的主叫信息，不等同于实际外呼主叫电话号码。未提供或为空时，当前网页呼叫实现使用调用者标识作为主叫展示信息
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for waiting for the call to be answered, in seconds. If the call is not answered within this period, it is actively hung up. The backend default is 60 seconds. This is not the maximum duration of an answered call. The current request object does not declare additional upper and lower limits, and unverified value ranges are not added to the documentation
parameters.help_zh: 等待呼叫接通的超时时间，单位秒。超过该时间仍未接通则主动挂断，后端默认60秒；不是已接通通话的最大持续时间。当前请求对象未声明额外的上下限，不在文档中新增未核实的取值范围
parameters.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en: The attached data string passed to the call link. It uses the key=value format. Multiple key-value pairs are separated by semicolons. It is not in JSON format. For example, the Callee key can be used by the web call service to read the called party information. The example number is a placeholder value. For actual business, fill it in according to the access agreement. Do not overwrite internal tags that are not within the business custom scope
parameters.help_zh: 传递给呼叫链路的随路数据字符串，使用key=value形式，多个键值对以分号分隔，不是JSON。例如Callee键可供网页呼叫服务读取被叫信息；示例号码为占位值，实际业务需按接入约定填写。不要覆盖不属于业务自定义范围的内部标记
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The audio sampling rate for web voice, in Hz. The backend default is 8000. It must match the client audio and gateway capabilities. The current API code does not define a complete list of allowed values, and other sampling rates are not written as guaranteed supported enumerations
parameters.help_zh: 网页语音音频采样率，单位Hz，后端默认8000。应与客户端音频及网关能力匹配；当前接口代码未定义完整允许值列表，不将其他采样率写成已保证支持的枚举
parameters.name: sample_rate

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the draft version. Valid values: true: uses the draft version. false: uses the published version. This is not a scenario publishing operation. Ensure that the selected scenario version exists before the call
parameters.help_zh: 场景版本选择：true使用草稿版本，false使用发布版本。不是场景发布操作；调用前需确保所选场景版本存在
parameters.name: draft_version

parameters.help_en: The visitor token obtained from the trial link. It is used to locate the trial channel and verify the access permissions and validity period. The token is generated by the channel service and must not be constructed manually. It cannot be empty and must still be within the validity period. The example is a placeholder value that cannot be used for authentication. Do not disclose the real token to unrelated personnel
parameters.help_zh: 从体验链接取得的访客令牌，用于定位试用渠道并校验访问权限和有效期。令牌由渠道服务生成，不应自行构造；不能为空，且必须仍在有效期内。示例为不可用于认证的占位值，请勿将真实令牌泄露给无关人员
parameters.name: visitor_token

schema.description_en: The business response of this API. Code=OK indicates success, and Data is the corresponding business result. For business errors, troubleshoot by combining Message and Params
schema.description_zh: 本次API的业务响应，Code=OK表示成功，Data为对应业务结果；业务错误结合Message及Params排查

Code.description_en: The business processing status code. OK indicates success. When an exception occurs, the corresponding business error code is returned. The error types and mapping rules follow the current API configuration, and no error codes are added or modified this time
Code.description_zh: 业务处理状态码，OK表示成功；发生异常时返回对应的业务错误码。错误类型和映射规则沿用当前API配置，本次不新增或修改错误码

Data.description_en: The session, channel, service address, and temporary authentication token for this web voice call. Use the actually returned connection parameters
Data.description_zh: 本次网页语音呼叫的会话、通道、服务地址和临时认证令牌。请使用实际返回的连接参数

ChannelId.description_en: The web voice connection channel ID assigned or returned by the RTC gateway. It is used to associate and connect the voice channel for this call. It is different from the trial channel AccessChannelId. You must use the real value returned by this API
ChannelId.description_zh: RTC网关分配或返回的网页语音连接通道标识，用于关联和连接本次呼叫的语音通道。不同于试用渠道AccessChannelId；必须使用本次接口返回的真实值

ExpirationTime.description_en: The expiration time of the web voice connection token for this call. The current POP type is string, and the backend WebCallContext type is long. The code does not mark the time unit. The format and unit must be confirmed according to the actual service provider agreement. The example is only a numeric string and does not represent a verified validity period unit
ExpirationTime.description_zh: 本次网页语音连接令牌的过期时间。当前POP类型为字符串，后端WebCallContext类型为long，代码未标注时间单位；格式和单位应按实际服务提供方约定确认。示例仅为数值字符串，不代表已核实的有效期单位

InstanceId.description_en: The instance identity of the associated product. You must use an instance that the invoker has access to and that actually exists. The instance must be consistent with the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definition
InstanceId.description_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准

ServerUrl.description_en: The service address used to establish the web voice connection for this call. The format and protocol are determined by the service provider of the RTC gateway. You must use the actual returned value and cannot concatenate it yourself. The example is an unconnectable desensitized address and does not represent a production domain name or protocol guarantee
ServerUrl.description_zh: 用于建立本次网页语音连接的服务地址，格式和协议由RTC网关的服务提供方决定。必须使用实际返回值，不能自行拼接；示例为不可连接的脱敏地址，不表示生产域名或协议保证

SessionId.description_en: The session ID used to uniquely associate this interaction. For a text session, it is the text- identifier returned when the session is started. For a web voice session, it is the ws- identifier. For a real number outbound call test, it is the test- identifier. Subsequent calls must use the actual returned value
SessionId.description_zh: 用于唯一关联本次交互的会话标识。文本会话为开启会话返回的text-标识，网页语音为ws-标识，真实号码外呼测试为test-标识；后续调用必须使用实际返回值

Token.description_en: The temporary token used to connect to the voice channel for this call. It must be used together with the ServerUrl and ChannelId returned this time. Do not disclose or record the actual token without desensitization. The example is not a valid credential, and the format and validity period are determined by the service provider
Token.description_zh: 连接本次语音通道的临时令牌，应与本次返回的ServerUrl和ChannelId配套使用。不得公开或记录未经脱敏的实际令牌；示例不是有效凭证，格式和有效期由服务提供方决定

Data.title_en: 网页语音呼叫连接上下文
Data.title_zh: 网页语音呼叫连接上下文

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code recorded in the business response body. A normal return is 200. To determine whether the business is successful, you must also check Code. You cannot determine that the call is successful solely based on the existence of this field
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应体记录的HTTP状态码，正常返回为200。判断业务是否成功还应检查Code，不能仅凭该字段存在认定调用成功

Message.description_en: The business response or error description. It is usually empty or not returned upon success, and it is not required to return a fixed text upon success. Upon failure, it is an error description used to assist troubleshooting, and it is combined with Code and Params to understand the cause of the error. The example is an error message when the trial link visitor token expires (corresponding to the Code Expired.VisitorToken), and is for format reference only
Message.description_zh: 业务响应或错误说明。成功时通常为空或不返回，不能要求成功时固定返回某段文本；失败时为错误说明，用于辅助排查，并结合Code与Params理解错误原因。示例为体验链接访客令牌过期时的错误消息（对应Code为Expired.VisitorToken），仅作格式参考

Params.description_en: The list of parameters used for the localized display of error messages. It is not a scenario variable or business result. A normal successful response is usually an empty array. When an error occurs, parameters corresponding to the error template may be returned
Params.description_zh: 用于错误消息本地化展示的参数列表，不是场景变量或业务结果。正常成功响应通常为空数组；出现错误时可能返回与错误模板对应的参数

items.description_en: A parameter value in the error message template. The specific content is determined by this error. The example InstanceId only demonstrates a possible field name and does not mean that this value is returned for every call
items.description_zh: 错误消息模板中的一个参数值。具体内容由本次错误决定；示例InstanceId仅演示可能的字段名，不表示每次调用均返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID used to associate and troubleshoot this POP request. The value in the response corresponds to this request. System request parameters are injected by the gateway, and the caller does not need to fill in the system fields
RequestId.description_zh: 用于关联和排查本次POP请求的标识。响应中的值对应本次请求；系统请求参数由网关注入，调用者不需要自行填写系统字段
